fields.label: Pause Intake
fields.description: The kill switch, and it is named for the OFF state on purpose. A brand-new Single has no row in tabSingles at all, so get_single_value returns None until something saves it — an `enabled` field would therefore read falsy and ship the feature dead on arrival (CLAUDE.md). Naming it `paused` makes the absent-row state the running state. When on, /feedback still lists existing requests but refuses new submissions.

fields.label: ERPNext Project
fields.description: Where ERPNext work is written. Defaults to PRJ-00580 in code as well as here, so the feature works on a site whose seed patch has not run — but this field is what the allowlist checks, and a proposed task naming any other Project is dropped.

fields.label: Triton Project
fields.description: Where Triton work is written. Defaults to PRJ-00755.

fields.label: Max Proposed Tasks
fields.description: Hard clamp on what one breakdown may propose, applied after parsing. A model asked for a work breakdown will happily return forty rows; a proposal nobody reads to the end is worse than a short one.

fields.label: Duplicate Scan Limit
fields.description: How many open Task subjects are sent for the duplicate check. Subjects only, most recently modified first — the two boards carry ~340 open tasks between them, so this is a ceiling rather than a sample.

fields.label: Breakdown Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Read timeout on the Triton call. Generous because this runs in a background job with nobody waiting on a spinner, and a truncated read costs a whole re-run.

fields.label: Notify On New Request
fields.description: Bell entry plus email when a request is filed. Empty means nobody is told and the review queue is the only surface — which is a valid choice, not an error.
